schema.description: RFC 7807 problem detail (ADR-0005), identical in shape to the OLTP API's.

type.description: Stable identifier for the error category.

title.description: Fixed human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: The report query is malformed or missing a required parameter

status.description: The HTTP status code, repeated in the body.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path this problem occurred on.

schema.title: Problem
